thread:
jess: FYI we've got repeated p95 spikes in eu2 dedicated pools around 11:10 UTC. Indicators point to ephemeral port pressure and conntrack growth, but not a full NAT outage.
omar: saw the same. small-gen requests hit tails when certain tenants burst new outbound TLS per-request.
nate: ops-bot shows nat-gw-eu2 snat_ports_in_use hit 96% briefly. ops-bot: ALERT snat-pressure eu2.
ops-bot: ACTION_CREATED: temp-route heavy tenants -> nat-gw-eu2b.
piper: Quick mitigation applied: rerouted heavy tenants for 20m -> nat-gw-eu2b and enabled envoy new_conn limiter on canary nodes. Latency dropped.
jess: Root cause appears to be several SDK clients opening fresh TLS per RPC. No keepalive or HTTP/2 multiplexing.
omar: short-term options: 1) keep routing to extra NAT GW (capex) 2) per-tenant egress proxy to multiplex connections (infra + ops cost) 3) sidecar/Envoy new_conn limiting (cheap, but may cause client errors)
nate: Proposal: implement a three-stage playbook: emergency routing -> apply envoy new_conn rate limiter -> provision small per-tenant multiplexer fleet for repeat offenders. Also add telemetry: per-tenant new_conn_rate, per-nat-gw port_use.
piper: I sketched cost math: spinning extra NGW cluster per region ~+$1.2k/mo; per-tenant proxy fleet (small) amortized about $400-900/mo depending on qps. SDK fixes are cheapest long-term.
ojps: (infra-oncall): applying guardrail: if nat-gw-eu2b >95% for >5m auto-revert and page infra-pager.
ops-bot: RESOLVED: routing reduced snat to 45% on nat-gw-eu2. Monitoring 1h.
jess: Follow-ups: 1) telemetry PR for new_conn and port metrics 2) ship envoy new_conn limiter rollout plan 3) draft per-tenant proxy runbook + perf tests 4) contact SEs/tenants with SDK pooling guidance and a suggested quick patch.
omar: Also add a scheduler soft-isolation tag option for tenants that cause kernel-level conntrack pressure to avoid eviction storms. We'll prototype in canary cluster.
ate: I'll own the cost comparison doc and the postmortem draft. Piper will own envoy rollout.
ops-bot: NOTE: auto-escalate at 95% SNAT for >5m.
jess: Thanks team — will add runbook entry "egress: snat-congestion -> proxy/reroute/limit" and ping product for SDK outreach.
